verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a knowledge-base app that already exposes a local HTTP API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only inbound integration surfaces: a local HTTP API server where callers POST method calls, the logseq:// x-callback-url protocol for invoking actions, and plugin APIs. None of these documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that notify a consumer of events, and the plugin API is at most a developer building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
